target_customer: Startups and small go-to-market teams that want automated revenue insights from sales, communication and billing data
problem: Early stage teams lack tooling that pulls revenue data together and answers questions about deals and pipeline without manual work.

founders.name: Kyle Archie
founders.background_notes: YC page: pre-ChatGPT LLM product research at Facebook, led Conversational AI and IMU Gestural Interface teams at Meta, two patents in conversational AI.

founders.name: Manuel Diaz-Granados
education: Carnegie Mellon, M.S. Electrical and Computer Engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page: ads web team at Rokt building ML pipeline integrations; research published in cloud computing, big data and computer vision.

founders.name: Egor Gagin
founders.background_notes: YC page: led AR/VR products at Meta and worked on an anxiety therapy product at a digital health startup; earlier worked in banking. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Patri
competitors.what: AI revenue intelligence that finds and refines a company's ideal customer profile

competitors.name: RevSure
competitors.what: Revenue intelligence and attribution for B2B sales and marketing teams
competitors.funding_then: raised a $10 million seed in June 2023

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting CRM, communication and billing sources and answering questions with LLMs was feasible for two engineers in 2023, but data integration and accuracy are real work.

defensibility.rationale: Thin LLM layer over third party data sources, with many funded revenue intelligence vendors and CRM vendors able to add the same insight features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented for this company. No source shows a copy or acquisition.

market_need_then: Revenue intelligence was an established category with multiple 2023 funding rounds (Patri, RevSure, CloseFactor), but demand from very early startups specifically was not evidenced in the sources found.

branding.domain_note: Uses lysto.ai, an AI top level domain. No purchase history found.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline promises set up in minutes, automatic insights and zero busy work

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or merch found. Name is easily confused with the Indian social commerce company Lysto and with Lystio.

outcome_analysis: Lysto was a two to three person Summer 2023 company with strong founder credentials from Meta and Rokt but only a reported $500K pre-seed and no later round found. The YC directory lists it as inactive, yet no shutdown notice, pivot or post-mortem was found, and the site fetch returned only a title. The cause of inactivity is therefore not public.
notes: The $500K pre-seed rests on a single database (VCBacked; Startup-seeker repeats it). StartupIntros items for Lysto dated 2021 and 2022 show a $3M and $12M seed but predate the 2023 company and are treated as a different company. The IdeaProof failure write-up concerns a different Lysto. Website fetch returned only the title Lysto AI so liveness is unclear. Competitors are adjacent revenue intelligence startups, since Gong and Clari had no source dated at the batch opened. Exit type unknown because YC status Inactive has no shutdown source.
